Swagger._comment: DEV ONLY credentials for /swagger. Development is the one environment where a missing password lets the documentation through; everywhere else an unconfigured password answers 503. Set real ones from the environment: Swagger__Auth__Username / Swagger__Auth__Password.

DefaultTenant._comment: The front-end's dev origin, so `dotnet run` yields a usable registry with no setup. The id is pinned to the value this seeder has always used, so an existing local database is recognised instead of gaining a second tenant.
DefaultTenant.Name: Sankore Dev

AdminJwt._comment: DEV ONLY signing key, so `dotnet run` starts with no setup. Set a real one per environment: AdminJwt__SigningKey.

PlatformAdmin._comment: Dev account. The password is NOT here: dotnet user-secrets set "PlatformAdmin:Password" "..." --project src/Bootstrapper/Sankore.Admin

TrialSignup._comment: DEV: trial institutions open on the local front-end (https://<name>.sankoreio.local:4222, the scheme the front is served on: the registry matches the address WHOLE). The website runs on ng serve (http://localhost:4200). No Turnstile secret: the captcha is skipped in Development only (logged).

Cors._comment: Origins of the admin front-end, scheme included. Empty outside Development means the browser blocks it (a warning is logged). '*' is refused at boot.
